findings.description: False positive: Regex pattern in Lisp lexer flagged as hardcoded credential

token_end = r'''
      (?=
        \s         # whitespace
        | ;        # comment
        | \#[;|!] # fancy comments
        | [)\]]    # end delimiters
        | $        # end of file
      )
    '''
findings.reasoning: This is a regex pattern used for token boundary detection in the Lisp lexer. The pattern defines lookahead assertions for whitespace, comments, and delimiters. This is part of the lexer's tokenization logic for syntax highlighting, not a hardcoded credential. The pattern is used to identify where tokens end in Lisp source code.
